//: ZITLAS composite indexes. Only queries that Firestore genuinely CANNOT serve are listed — each entry below was verified by running the real query against the live project and observing FAILED_PRECONDITION. Equality-only queries (device_tokens uid+enabled, personal_coach_requests athleteId+status, expert_ratings expertId+status) were tested too and Firestore serves them by merging single-field indexes, so declaring them would be noise. Deploy with: firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes

indexes.//: coaching_sweep.sweep_expired_requests — the 48h request-expiry sweep, scheduled every 15 minutes (main.py:208). Equality on `status` combined with a RANGE on `expiresAt` cannot be served by single-field indexes. VERIFIED FAILING in production: this is the FailedPrecondition filling the Render logs, and it means the sweep has never actually run.

coaching_sweep.sweep_expired_relationships — the 30d relationship-expiry sweep, also every 15 minutes (main.py:215). Same shape: equality on `status`, range on `endDateTs`. VERIFIED FAILING in production.
